verses.1:1: There was a certain man in the land of Uz whose name was Job; and that man was truthful, blameless, righteous, God-fearing, keeping away from every evil thing.
verses.1:2: And seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
verses.1:3: And his livestock was seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yokes of oxen, and five hundred grazing female donkeys. And he had a very large body of servants and great works on the earth; and that man was noble among those from the rising of the sun.
verses.1:4: And his sons, coming together to one another, would hold a banquet each day, bringing along their three sisters at the same time to eat and drink with them.
verses.1:5: And whenever the days of the banquet were completed, Job would send and purify them, rising up in the morning, and would offer a sacrifice on their behalf according to their number and one calf for sin on behalf of their souls; for Job would say, "Perhaps my sons have thought evil things in their mind toward God." So then Job would do this all the days.
verses.1:6: And when this day came, look, the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came with them.
verses.1:7: And the Lord said to the devil, "Where have you come from?" And the devil answered the Lord and said, "Having gone around the earth and walked about what is under heaven, I am here."
verses.1:8: And the Lord said to him, "Have you given attention in your mind to My servant Job? For there is no one like him among those on the earth, a blameless, truthful, God-fearing man, keeping away from every evil thing."
verses.1:9: And the devil answered and said before the Lord, "Does Job revere the Lord for nothing?
verses.1:10: Have You not fenced around what is outside him and what is inside his house and what is outside all that belongs to him all around? You have blessed the works of his hands, and You have made his livestock numerous on the earth.
verses.1:11: But stretch out Your hand and touch all that he has; surely he will bless You to Your face."
verses.1:12: Then the Lord said to the devil, "Look, all that belongs to him I give into your hand, but do not touch him." And the devil went out from the presence of the Lord.
verses.1:13: And it happened on a day like this that the sons of Job and his daughters were drinking wine in the house of their oldest brother.
verses.1:14: And look, a messenger came to Job and said to him, "The yokes of oxen were plowing, and the female donkeys were grazing beside them,
verses.1:15: and the captors came and took them captive, and killed the servants with swords; and having been saved, I alone came to report to you."
verses.1:16: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, "Fire fell from heaven and burned up the sheep, and devoured the shepherds likewise; and having been saved, I alone came to report to you."
verses.1:17: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, "The horsemen formed three divisions against us, and surrounded the camels and took them captive, and killed the servants with swords; and I alone was saved and came to report to you."
verses.1:18: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came, saying to Job, "While your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking with their oldest brother,
verses.1:19: suddenly a great wind came in from the wilderness and touched the four corners of the house; and the house fell upon your children, and they died; and I alone was saved and came to report to you."
verses.1:20: So Job rose up and tore his garments and shaved the hair of his head, and falling to the ground, he worshiped
verses.1:21: and said, "I myself came out naked from my mother's womb, and naked I will depart there. The Lord gave, the Lord took away; as it seemed good to the Lord, so it came to be; may the name of the Lord be blessed."
verses.1:22: In all these things that happened to him, Job did not sin at all before the Lord, and he did not ascribe folly to God.
verses.2:1: Now it happened on a day like this that the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came in their midst to stand before the Lord.
verses.2:2: And the Lord said to the devil, "Where are you coming from?" Then the devil said before the Lord, "Having passed through what is under heaven and walked about the whole of it, I am here."
verses.2:3: And the Lord said to the devil, "Have you then given attention to My servant Job? For there is no one like him among those on the earth, an innocent, truthful, blameless, God-fearing man, keeping away from every evil. And he still holds fast to innocence; yet you said to destroy his possessions without cause."
verses.2:4: And the devil replied and said to the Lord, "Skin for skin; all that a man has he will pay out for his life.
verses.2:5: Nevertheless, stretch out Your hand and touch his bones and his flesh; surely he will bless You to Your face."
verses.2:6: And the Lord said to the devil, "Look, I hand him over to you; only preserve his life."
verses.2:7: And the devil went out from the Lord, and he struck Job with a malignant sore from his feet to his head.
verses.2:8: And he took a potsherd to scrape away the discharge, and he was sitting on the dung heap outside the city.
verses.2:9: And when much time had passed, his wife said to him, "How long will you endure, saying, 'Look, I will wait a little time longer, awaiting the hope of my deliverance'? For look, your memorial has been wiped out from the earth, sons and daughters, the birth pangs and labors of my womb, for whom I toiled in vain with hardships. And you yourself sit in the decay of worms, spending the night in the open air; and I wander about and serve for hire, from place to place and from house to house, awaiting the sun, when it will set, so that I may rest from my hardships and the pains that now grip me. But speak some word against the Lord, and die."
verses.2:10: And looking intently, he said to her, "You have spoken like one of the foolish women; if we received the good things from the hand of the Lord, will we not bear the evil things?" In all these things that happened to him, Job did not sin at all with his lips before God.
verses.2:11: Now when his three friends heard of all the evil things that had come upon him, they came to him, each from his own land: Eliphaz, king of the Temanites, Bildad, ruler of the Shuhites, and Zophar, king of the Minaeans; and they came to him with one accord to comfort and visit him.
verses.2:12: And seeing him from a distance, they did not recognize him, and crying out with a loud voice, they wept, each tearing his own robe, and sprinkling earth on themselves.
verses.2:13: They sat beside him seven days and seven nights, and none of them spoke; for they saw that the affliction was dreadful and very great.
verses.3:1: After this Job opened his mouth
verses.3:3: "May the day perish on which I was born, and that night in which they said, 'Look, a male!'
verses.3:4: May that night be darkness, and may the Lord not seek after it from above, nor may brightness come into it;
verses.3:5: and may darkness and the shadow of death seize it; may gloom come upon it.
verses.3:6: May the day and that night be cursed; may darkness carry it away; may it not be among the days of a year, nor may it be numbered among the days of months.
verses.3:7: But may that night be pain, and may neither gladness nor joy come upon it;
verses.3:8: but may the one who curses that day curse it, the one who is about to subdue the great sea monster.
verses.3:9: May the stars of that night be darkened; may it wait and not come to light, and may it not see the morning star rising,
verses.3:10: because it did not shut the gates of my mother's womb; for it would have removed trouble from my eyes.
verses.3:11: For why did I not die in the womb? And did I come out from the womb and not immediately perish?
verses.3:12: And why did the knees meet me? And why did I nurse at breasts?
verses.3:13: Now, having lain down, I would have been quiet, and having fallen asleep, I would have rested
verses.3:14: with kings, counselors of the earth, who gloried in swords,
verses.3:15: or with rulers whose gold was abundant, who filled their houses with silver,
verses.3:16: or like a stillborn child coming out from a mother's womb, or like infants who did not see light.
verses.3:17: There the ungodly have kindled the fury of wrath; there those weary in body have rested;
verses.3:18: and together the eternal ones have not heard the voice of a tax collector.
verses.3:19: Small and great are there, and a servant who fears his master.
verses.3:20: For why has light been given to those in bitterness, and life to souls in pain,
verses.3:21: who long for death and do not obtain it, digging for it like treasures?
verses.3:22: And they become overjoyed if they do obtain it.
verses.3:23: Death is rest for a man, for God has shut him in.
verses.3:24: For before my food, groaning comes, and I weep, gripped by fear.
verses.3:25: For the fear that I worried about has come to me, and what I feared has met me.
verses.3:26: I was neither at peace, nor was I quiet, nor did I rest, yet wrath came to me."
verses.4:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.4:2: "Have you often been spoken to in trouble? Yet who will endure the strength of your words?
verses.4:3: For if you admonished many, and encouraged the hands of the weak,
verses.4:4: and raised up with words those who were weak, and placed courage around powerless knees;
verses.4:5: but now pain has come upon you and touched you; you have become agitated.
verses.4:6: Is not your fear in folly, and your hope, and the wickedness of your way?
verses.4:7: Remember, then: who, being pure, perished, or when did true ones perish root and all?
verses.4:8: Just as I saw those who plow wrongful things, those who sow them will reap sorrows for themselves.
verses.4:9: By the command of the Lord they will perish, and by the breath of His anger they will be wiped out.
verses.4:10: The might of a lion, and the voice of a lioness, and the exultation of dragons were extinguished.
verses.4:11: An ant-lion perished because it had no food, and lion cubs left one another.
verses.4:12: But if any true word had been in your speeches, none of these evils would have met you. Will not my ear receive extraordinary things from Him?
verses.4:13: Now fear and a night echo, fear falling upon people,
verses.4:14: shuddering and trembling met me and greatly shook my bones,
verses.4:15: and a spirit came upon my face, and my hair and flesh shuddered.
verses.4:16: I stood up, and did not recognize it; I looked, and there was no form before my eyes, except that I heard a breeze and a voice:
verses.4:17: 'What then? Will a mortal be pure before the Lord? Or will a man be blameless from his works?'
verses.4:18: If He does not put trust in His servants, and against His angels He detected something crooked,
verses.4:19: then as for those who dwell in houses of clay, of whom we ourselves also are from the same clay, He struck them like a moth.
verses.4:20: And from morning until evening they are no more; because they were unable to help themselves, they perished.
verses.4:21: For He breathed on them and they withered; they perished because they had no wisdom."
verses.5:1: "Now call out, if anyone will answer you, or if you will see any of the holy angels.
verses.5:2: For indeed anger kills a fool, and jealousy puts to death one who has gone astray.
verses.5:3: And I have seen fools putting down a root, but immediately their dwelling was devoured.
verses.5:4: May their sons be far from safety, and may they be humiliated at the doors of inferiors, and there will be no rescuer.
verses.5:5: For what those people gathered, the righteous will eat, while they themselves will not be rescued from evils; may their strength be siphoned away.
verses.5:6: For trouble will certainly not come out from the earth, nor will pain sprout from the mountains;
verses.5:7: rather, a human being is born for trouble, while the young of a vulture fly to the heights.
verses.5:8: Nevertheless, I will plead with the Lord, and I will call upon the Lord, the Master of all,
verses.5:9: who does great and unsearchable things, glorious and extraordinary things, of which there is no number;
verses.5:10: who gives rain upon the earth, sending water upon what is under heaven;
verses.5:11: who sets the lowly on high, and raises up those who have perished;
verses.5:12: who alters the plans of the crafty, and their hands will certainly not accomplish what is true.
verses.5:13: He is the One who catches the wise in shrewdness, and He confounded the plan of the devious.
verses.5:14: By day darkness will meet them, and at noon may they grope just as at night.
verses.5:15: And may they perish in war, and may the powerless escape from the hand of a powerful one;
verses.5:16: and may there be hope for the powerless, and may the mouth of the unrighteous be stopped.
verses.5:17: Now blessed is the person whom the Lord reproved; and do not reject the admonition of the Almighty.
verses.5:18: For He Himself causes pain and restores again; He struck, and His hands healed.
verses.5:19: Six times He will rescue you from distresses, and in the seventh evil will certainly not touch you.
verses.5:20: In famine He will deliver you from death, and in war He will release you from the hand of iron.
verses.5:21: From the lash of the tongue He will hide you, and you will certainly not be afraid of coming evils.
verses.5:22: You will laugh at the unrighteous and the lawless, and you will certainly not be afraid of wild beasts.
verses.5:23: For wild beasts will be at peace with you.
verses.5:24: Then you will know that your house will be at peace, and the dwelling of your tent will certainly not fail.
verses.5:25: And you will know that your seed is numerous, and your children will be like all the vegetation of the field.
verses.5:26: And you will come to the grave like ripe grain reaped in season, or like a heap on a threshing floor gathered in at the right time.
verses.5:27: Look, we have searched out these things in this way; these are the things we have heard; and as for you, know for yourself if you have done anything."
verses.6:2: "If only someone would truly weigh my anger, and lift up my pains in a balance all together,
verses.6:3: then indeed it will be heavier than the sand of the seashore; but as it seems, my words are worthless.
verses.6:4: For the arrows of the Lord are in my body, whose fury drinks up my blood; whenever I begin to speak, they pierce me.
verses.6:5: What then? Will a wild donkey cry out for nothing, unless seeking food? Or will an ox also break forth with a cry at a manger while having food?
verses.6:6: Will bread be eaten without salt? Or is there also taste in empty words?
verses.6:7: For my anger cannot cease; for I see my food as a stench, like the smell of a lion.
verses.6:8: If only He would grant it, and my request would come, and the Lord would grant my hope.
verses.6:9: Having begun, let the Lord wound me, yet let Him not destroy me completely.
verses.6:10: And may my city be a grave, upon whose walls I used to leap. I will not spare; for I have not lied about the holy words of my God.
verses.6:11: For what is my strength, that I endure? Or what is my time, that my soul bears up?
verses.6:12: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
verses.6:13: Or did I not trust in Him? Yet help is absent from me.
verses.6:14: Mercy has rejected me, and the visitation of the Lord has overlooked me.
verses.6:15: Those closest to me did not look upon me; like a failing winter torrent, or like a wave, they passed me by;
verses.6:16: those who used to revere me have now fallen upon me like snow or frozen ice;
verses.6:17: just as, having melted when heat came, it was not recognized for what it was,
verses.6:18: so I also was forsaken by all, and I perished and became homeless.
verses.6:19: Look at the ways of the Temanites, the paths of the Sabeans, you who observe;
verses.6:20: and those who trust in cities and wealth will incur shame.
verses.6:21: Yet you also have set upon me without mercy; therefore, seeing my wound, be afraid.
verses.6:22: What then? Did I ask anything from you, or am I in need of strength from you,
verses.6:23: so as to save me from enemies, or to deliver me from the hand of mighty ones?
verses.6:24: Teach me, and I will be silent; if I have gone astray in anything, tell me.
verses.6:25: But as it seems, the words of one who is truthful are worthless, for I am not asking for strength from you;
verses.6:26: nor will your reproof stop me with words, for neither will I bear the sound of a word from you.
verses.6:27: However, you fall upon an orphan, and you leap upon your friend.
verses.6:28: But now, looking into your faces, I will not lie.
verses.6:29: Sit down now, and let there be no injustice, and come together again with the righteous one.
verses.6:30: For there is no injustice on my tongue; or does my throat not meditate on understanding?"
verses.7:1: "Is not the life of man upon the earth a trial, and his life like that of a daily hired worker?
verses.7:2: Or like a servant fearing his master and having obtained shade, or like a hired laborer waiting for his wages?
verses.7:3: So I also have endured empty months, and nights of pain have been given to me.
verses.7:4: If I lie down, I say, 'When will it be day?' And whenever I rise, again, 'When will it be evening?' And I become full of pains from evening until morning.
verses.7:5: And my body is defiled in the decay of worms, and I dissolve clods of earth with discharge as I scrape.
verses.7:6: And my life is swifter than speech, and it has perished in empty hope.
verses.7:7: Remember therefore that my life is a breath, and my eye will no longer return to see good.
verses.7:8: The eye of one who sees me will not look upon me; Your eyes are upon me, and I am no more,
verses.7:9: like a cloud cleared away from the sky. For if a man goes down to Hades, he will never again come up,
verses.7:10: nor will he ever return to his own house, nor will his place ever recognize him again.
verses.7:11: Therefore neither will I spare my mouth; I will speak, being in distress; I will open the bitterness of my soul, being hard pressed.
verses.7:12: Am I a sea or a dragon, that You have stationed a guard over me?
verses.7:13: I said, 'My bed will comfort me, and I will bring up a word privately to myself on my couch';
verses.7:14: You frighten me with dreams, and in visions You terrify me.
verses.7:15: You will separate my soul from my spirit, and my bones from death.
verses.7:16: For I will not live forever, that I should be patient; depart from me, for my life is empty.
verses.7:17: For what is man, that You have magnified him? Or that You direct Your mind to him?
verses.7:18: Or will You make a visitation of him until the morning, and judge him until rest?
verses.7:19: How long will You not leave me alone nor let me go, until I swallow my saliva in pain?
verses.7:20: If I have sinned, what will I be able to do, You who know the mind of men? Why have You set me as Your accuser, and am I a burden to You?
verses.7:21: And why have You not made a forgetting of my lawlessness and a cleansing of my sin? But now I will depart to the earth, and rising early, I am no more."
verses.8:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.8:2: "How long will you speak these things? The wind of your mouth is full of words.
verses.8:3: Will the Lord act unjustly when He judges? Or will He who made all things disturb justice?
verses.8:4: If your sons sinned before Him, He sent them away in the hand of their lawlessness.
verses.8:5: But you, turn early to the Lord Almighty, pleading.
verses.8:6: If you are pure and truthful, He will listen to your plea, and He will restore to you a dwelling of righteousness;
verses.8:7: therefore your former state will be small, but your latter state will be beyond telling.
verses.8:8: For inquire of a former generation, and search out according to the lineage of fathers;
verses.8:9: for we are from yesterday and do not know, for our life on the earth is a shadow.
verses.8:10: Or will these not teach you and tell you, and bring out words from the heart?
verses.8:11: Does papyrus flourish without water? Or will sedge grow tall without drink?
verses.8:12: While it is still on the root, it will certainly not be harvested; before drinking, does not every plant dry up?
verses.8:13: Thus, then, will be the latter state of all who forget the Lord; for the hope of an ungodly person will perish.
verses.8:14: For his house will be uninhabited, and his tent will turn out to be a spider's web.
verses.8:15: If he props up his house, it will certainly not stand; and when he takes hold of it, it will certainly not endure;
verses.8:16: for he is moist under the sun, and out of his decay his shoot will come out.
verses.8:17: On a heap of stones he sleeps, and in the midst of pebbles he will live.
verses.8:18: If it swallows him up, the place will deceive him; you have not seen such things.
verses.8:19: For such is the overthrow of an ungodly person, and out of the earth it will cause another to sprout.
verses.8:20: For the Lord will certainly not reject the innocent person, and He will not accept any gift of an ungodly person.
verses.8:21: But He will fill the mouth of the truthful with laughter, and their lips with thanksgiving;
verses.8:22: and their enemies will clothe themselves with shame, and the dwelling of an ungodly person will not exist."
verses.9:2: "In truth I know that it is so. For how will a mortal be righteous before the Lord?
verses.9:3: For if he wishes to enter into judgment with Him, he will certainly not answer Him, so that he may not reply to one word of His out of a thousand.
verses.9:4: For He is wise in mind, both mighty and great; who has become hard before Him and endured?
verses.9:5: He who makes mountains old—they do not know—He who overturns them in anger;
verses.9:6: He who shakes the earth under heaven from its foundations, and its pillars totter;
verses.9:7: He who speaks to the sun and it does not rise, and seals up the stars,
verses.9:8: He who stretched out heaven alone, walking as on ground upon the sea;
verses.9:9: He who makes the Pleiades and Hesperus and Arcturus and the chambers of the South;
verses.9:10: He who does great and unsearchable things, both glorious and extraordinary things, of which there is no number.
verses.9:11: If He passes over me, I will certainly not see; and if He passes by me, not even so have I known.
verses.9:12: If He takes away, who will turn Him back? Or who will say to Him, 'What have You done?'
verses.9:13: For He Himself has turned away anger; by Him the sea monsters under heaven were bowed down.
verses.9:14: But if He will heed me, surely He will judge my words.
verses.9:15: For if I am righteous, He will not listen to me; I will plead for His judgment;
verses.9:16: and if I call and He does not answer, I do not believe that He has listened to me.
verses.9:17: Could He crush me with gloom? Yet He has made my bruises many for nothing.
verses.9:18: For He does not allow me to take a breath, but He has filled me with bitterness.
verses.9:19: For because He is strong, He prevails; who then will stand against His judgment?
verses.9:20: For if I am righteous, my mouth will be ungodly; and if I am blameless, I will turn out crooked.
verses.9:21: For even if I acted ungodly, I do not know in my soul, yet my life is being taken away.
verses.9:22: Therefore I said, 'Anger destroys the great and the mighty,
verses.9:23: because the worthless are in a dreadful death, yet the righteous are mocked;
verses.9:24: for they have been handed over into the hands of an ungodly person.' He covers the faces of its judges; and if it is not He, who is it?
verses.9:25: Now my life is swifter than a runner; they fled away, and they did not see.
verses.9:26: Or is there indeed a trace of a way for ships, or of a flying eagle seeking prey?
verses.9:27: For even if I speak, I will forget while speaking; bowing my face down, I will groan.
verses.9:28: I am shaken in all my limbs, for I know that You will not leave me innocent.
verses.9:29: But since I am ungodly, why did I not die?
verses.9:30: For if I wash myself with snow, and cleanse myself with clean hands,
verses.9:31: You have thoroughly dipped me in filth, and my robe has detested me.
verses.9:32: For You are not a man like me against whom I may contend, so that we may come together into judgment.
verses.9:33: If only there were a mediator for us, both reproving and hearing thoroughly between both of us;
verses.9:34: let Him remove the rod from me, and let the fear of Him not whirl me about,
verses.9:35: and I will certainly not be afraid, but I will speak; for I do not know myself to be so."
verses.10:1: "I am weary in my soul. Groaning, I will let loose my words against Him; I will speak, constrained by the bitterness of my soul,
verses.10:2: and I will say to the Lord, 'Do not teach me to act ungodly; and why have You judged me this way?
verses.10:3: Or is it good to You if I act unjustly, that You have renounced the works of Your hands, while You have paid attention to the counsel of the ungodly?
verses.10:4: Or as a mortal sees, do You observe? Or just as a human being sees, will You look?
verses.10:5: Or is Your life human, or are Your years those of a man,
verses.10:6: that You have searched out my lawlessness and tracked down my sins?
verses.10:7: For You know that I have not acted ungodly; yet who is there who delivers from Your hands?
verses.10:8: Your hands molded me and made me; after these things, turning around, You struck me.
verses.10:9: Remember that You molded me as clay, yet to earth You are turning me back again.
verses.10:10: Or did You not milk me like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
verses.10:11: With skin and flesh You clothed me, and with bones and sinews You wove me together;
verses.10:12: and life and mercy You placed with me, and Your oversight guarded my spirit.
verses.10:13: You have these things within Yourself; I know that You can do all things, and nothing is impossible for You.
verses.10:14: For if I sin, You watch me, and from lawlessness You have not made me guiltless.
verses.10:15: For if I act ungodly, woe to me! And if I am righteous, I cannot look up, for I am full of dishonor.
verses.10:16: For I am hunted like a lion for slaughter; for turning around again, You terribly destroy me,
verses.10:17: renewing my examination against me; and with great wrath You dealt with me, and You brought raiding bands against me.
verses.10:18: Why then did You bring me out from the womb, and I did not die, and no eye saw me,
verses.10:19: and I became as one not existing? For why was I not removed from the womb to the tomb?
verses.10:20: Or is the life of my time not short? Let me rest a little
verses.10:21: before I depart, from where I will not return, to a dark and gloomy land,
verses.10:22: to a land of eternal darkness, where there is no light, nor seeing the life of mortals.'"
verses.11:1: Then Zophar the Minaean answered and said:
verses.11:2: "The one who says many things will also hear in return; or does the eloquent one also think he is righteous?
verses.11:3: Blessed is the short-lived one born of a woman. Do not be abundant in words, for there is no one who answers you back.
verses.11:4: For do not say, 'I am pure in my works and blameless before Him.'
verses.11:5: But how would the Lord speak to you? And will He open His lips with you?
verses.11:6: Then He will declare to you the power of wisdom, for He will be double what concerns you; and then you will know that things worthy of what you have sinned have come upon you from the Lord.
verses.11:7: Or will you find a trace of the Lord? Or have you reached the utmost limits that the Almighty made?
verses.11:8: Heaven is high, and what will you do? And they are deeper than the things in Hades; what do you know?
verses.11:9: Or longer than the measure of the earth or the breadth of the sea.
verses.11:10: And if He overturns all things, who will say to Him, 'What have You done?'
verses.11:11: For He Himself knows the works of the lawless, and seeing wrongful things, He will not overlook them.
verses.11:12: But a man swims idly in words, and a mortal born of a woman is like a desert donkey.
verses.11:13: For if you have made your heart pure, and hold up your hands toward Him;
verses.11:14: if there is anything lawless in your hands, put it far away from you, and do not let injustice lodge in your dwelling.
verses.11:15: For in this way your face will shine like pure water, and you will put off filth and will certainly not be afraid;
verses.11:16: and you will forget your toil like a wave that has passed by, and you will not be terrified;
verses.11:17: and your prayer will be like the morning star, and from midday life will rise for you;
verses.11:18: and you will be confident that there is hope for you, and out of anxiety and care peace will appear for you.
verses.11:19: For you will be at rest, and there will be no one fighting against you; and many, turning around, will plead with you.
verses.11:20: But salvation will forsake them; for their hope is destruction, and the eyes of the ungodly will melt away."
verses.12:2: "So then, you are human beings; indeed, wisdom will die with you.
verses.12:3: I also have a heart like yours.
verses.12:4: For a righteous and blameless man has become a laughingstock;
verses.12:5: for he had been prepared for an appointed time to fall by others, and for his houses to be plundered by the lawless.
verses.12:6: Nevertheless, let no one who is wicked be confident that he will be guiltless, all who provoke the Lord to anger, as though there will not also be an examination of them.
verses.12:7: But now, ask the four-footed animals if they will tell you, and the birds of heaven if they will report to you;
verses.12:8: speak to the earth if it will inform you, and the fish of the sea will explain to you.
verses.12:9: Who then has not known among all these that the hand of the Lord made these things?
verses.12:10: Is not the soul of all living things and the spirit of every human being in His hand?
verses.12:11: For the mind discerns words, and the throat tastes food.
verses.12:12: In much time is wisdom, and in a long life is knowledge.
verses.12:13: With Him are wisdom and power; His are counsel and understanding.
verses.12:14: If He tears down, who will build? If He shuts against people, who will open?
verses.12:15: If He holds back the water, He will dry up the earth; and if He lets it loose, He destroys it by overturning it.
verses.12:16: With Him are might and strength; His are knowledge and understanding.
verses.12:17: He leads counselors away captive, and drives the judges of the earth out of their minds.
verses.12:18: He seats kings upon thrones, and binds their waists with a belt.
verses.12:19: He sends priests away captive, and overturns the mighty ones of the earth.
verses.12:20: He changes the lips of the trustworthy, and knows the understanding of the elders.
verses.12:21: He pours out dishonor upon rulers, and heals the humble.
verses.12:22: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out the shadow of death into light.
verses.12:23: He lays nations low and guides them.
verses.12:24: He changes the hearts of the rulers of the earth, and leads them astray in a way they did not know.
verses.12:25: May they grope in darkness and not light, and may they wander astray like a drunkard."
verses.13:1: "Look, my eye has seen these things, and my ear has heard them.
verses.13:2: And I know as much as you also understand, and I am no less intelligent than you.
verses.13:3: Nevertheless, I will speak to the Lord, and I will argue before Him if He wills.
verses.13:4: But you are unjust physicians and healers of evils, all of you.
verses.13:5: Yet may it be yours to keep silent, and it will turn out to be wisdom for you.
verses.13:6: Hear the argument of my mouth, and pay attention to the judgment of my lips.
verses.13:7: Do you not speak before the Lord, and before Him utter deceit?
verses.13:8: Or will you shrink back? Rather, you yourselves become judges.
verses.13:9: For is it good if He searches you out? For if, doing all things, you attach yourselves to Him,
verses.13:10: nonetheless He will reprove you; and if even in secret you show partiality,
verses.13:11: will not His terrors whirl you about? And the dread from Him will fall upon you,
verses.13:12: and your boasting will turn out like ashes, and your body made of clay.
verses.13:13: Keep silent, so that I may speak and find rest from anger,
verses.13:14: taking my flesh in my teeth, and I will place my soul in my hand.
verses.13:15: If the Mighty One overpowers me, since He has indeed begun, surely I will speak and argue before Him.
verses.13:16: And this will turn out for my salvation, for deceit will not enter before Him.
verses.13:17: Hear, hear my words, for I will declare them in your hearing.
verses.13:18: Look, I am near to my judgment; I know that I will be shown righteous.
verses.13:19: For who is the one who will contend with me, that now I will keep silent and expire?
verses.13:20: Yet deal with me in two things; then I will not hide myself from Your face:
verses.13:21: Keep Your hand away from me, and do not let the dread of You terrify me.
verses.13:22: Then if You call, I will answer You; or if You speak, I will give You a reply.
verses.13:23: How many are my sins and my iniquities? Teach me what they are.
verses.13:24: Why do You hide Yourself from me, and consider me an adversary to You?
verses.13:25: Or will You be wary as of a leaf moved by wind, or do You stand against me as against grass carried by a gust?
verses.13:26: For You wrote down evils against me, and placed upon me sins of youth.
verses.13:27: And You put my foot in a restraint, and You watched all my deeds, and You came to the roots of my feet,
verses.13:28: which wears out like a wineskin, or like a moth-eaten garment."
verses.14:1: "For a mortal born of a woman is short-lived and full of wrath,
verses.14:2: or like a flower that has blossomed, he falls away; and he flees like a shadow and will never remain.
verses.14:3: Have You not taken account even of this one, and made this one enter into judgment before You?
verses.14:4: For who will be clean from filth? No, not one,
verses.14:5: even if his life on the earth is one day. And his months are numbered by Him; You appointed him for a time, and he will never pass beyond it.
verses.14:6: Withdraw from him so that he may rest and take pleasure in life, like a hired worker.
verses.14:7: For there is hope for a tree; for if it is cut down, it will blossom again, and its shoot will never fail.
verses.14:8: For if its root grows old in the earth, and in rock dies
verses.14:9: its stump, from the scent of water it will blossom, and it will produce a harvest like a young plant.
verses.14:10: But when a man dies, he is gone, and when a mortal falls, he is no more.
verses.14:11: For in time a sea becomes depleted, and a river, left desolate, dries up.
verses.14:12: And when a man has fallen asleep, he will never rise until heaven is not sewn together, and they will not be awakened from their sleep.
verses.14:13: If only You had kept me in Hades, and hidden me until Your wrath ceases, and would appoint a time for me in which You will remember me.
verses.14:14: For if a man dies, he will live, having completed the days of his life; I will wait until I come into being again.
verses.14:15: Then You will call, and I will answer You; and do not reject the works of Your hands.
verses.14:16: Yet You numbered my practices, and not one of my sins will pass You by.
verses.14:17: And You sealed my iniquities in a pouch, and You marked down if I transgressed in anything unwillingly.
verses.14:18: And yet a falling mountain will fall apart, and a rock will wear away from its place.
verses.14:19: Waters wear stones smooth, and waters flood the level places of the soil of the earth; and You destroy the endurance of man.
verses.14:20: You thrust him away to the end, and he is gone; You set Your face against him and send him away.
verses.14:21: And when his sons become many, he does not know, and if they become few, he does not understand;
verses.14:22: only his flesh feels pain, and his soul mourns."
verses.15:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.15:2: "Will a wise man give an answer of understanding of wind, and fill the pain of his belly,
verses.15:3: reproving with words one ought not to use, with speeches in which there is no benefit?
verses.15:4: Did you not also cast off fear, and carry out such words before the Lord?
verses.15:5: You are guilty by the words of your mouth, and you did not discern the words of the mighty.
verses.15:6: May your own mouth reprove you, and not I, and your lips will testify against you.
verses.15:7: What then? Were you born the first of men? Or were you solidified before the hills?
verses.15:8: Or have you heard the ordinance of the Lord? And has wisdom reached you?
verses.15:9: For what do you know that we do not know? Or what do you understand that we also do not?
verses.15:10: Both an old man and an ancient one are among us, heavier in days than your father.
verses.15:11: You have been scourged for few of the things you have sinned; you have spoken greatly, exceedingly.
verses.15:12: What did your heart dare? Or what did your eyes bring forward,
verses.15:13: that you burst out in wrath before the Lord, and brought out such words from your mouth?
verses.15:14: For who is a mortal, that he will be blameless, or one born of a woman, as one who will be righteous?
verses.15:15: If He does not trust in holy ones, and heaven is not pure before Him,
verses.15:16: let alone one who is abominable and impure, a man drinking injustices like a drink.
verses.15:17: Now I will declare to you, listen to me; what indeed I have seen I will declare to you,
verses.15:18: what wise men will say, which they did not hide from their fathers.
verses.15:19: To them alone the land was given, and no foreigner came upon them.
verses.15:20: All the life of an ungodly man is in anxiety, and numbered years are given to a mighty man,
verses.15:21: and his fear is in his ears; whenever he thinks he is already at peace, his overthrow will come.
verses.15:22: Let him not trust that he will turn back from darkness; for he has already been ordered into the hands of iron,
verses.15:23: and he has been assigned as food for vultures; and he knows within himself that he remains for a fall. And a dark day will whirl him about,
verses.15:24: and distress and affliction will seize him, like a general in the front rank falling;
verses.15:25: because he has lifted up his hands against the Lord, and before the Lord Almighty he stiffened his neck,
verses.15:26: and he ran against Him with insolence, with the thickness of the back of his shield;
verses.15:27: because he covered his face with his fat, and made a fold upon his thighs.
verses.15:28: And may he lodge in desolate cities, and may he enter into uninhabited houses; and what those men prepared, others will carry away.
verses.15:29: Neither will he become rich, nor will his possessions remain; he will by no means cast a shadow on the earth,
verses.15:30: nor will he escape the darkness; may a wind wither his shoot, and may his blossom fall off.
verses.15:31: Let him not trust that he will endure, for empty things will come about for him;
verses.15:32: his cutting will be destroyed before the season, and his young branch will by no means grow dense;
verses.15:33: and may he be harvested like an unripe grape before the season, and may he fall off like the blossom of an olive tree.
verses.15:34: For the testimony of an ungodly man is death, and fire will burn the houses of bribe-takers.
verses.15:35: And he will conceive pains in the womb, and empty things will come about for him, and his belly will bear deceit."
verses.16:2: "I have heard many such things; you are all comforters of evils.
verses.16:3: What then? Is there any order to words of wind? Or what will trouble you that you answer?
verses.16:4: I also will speak like you. If indeed your soul were put in place of mine, then I would pounce on you with words, and I would shake my head against you.
verses.16:5: And may there be strength in my mouth, and I will not spare the movement of my lips.
verses.16:6: For if I speak, I will not feel pain in the wound; and even if I keep silent, in what way will I be wounded less?
verses.16:7: But now He has made me exhausted, foolish, rotten, and You seized me.
verses.16:8: It became a testimony; and my falsehood rose up in me; it answered back to my face.
verses.16:9: Acting in wrath, He cast me down; He gnashed His teeth at me; the arrows of His raiders fell upon me.
verses.16:10: With the sharp points of His eyes He pounced; with a sharp edge He struck me on the knees, and with one accord they rushed down upon me.
verses.16:11: For the Lord handed me over into the hands of an unrighteous man, and threw me upon ungodly men.
verses.16:12: While I was at peace, He scattered me; seizing me by the hair, He plucked it out; He set me up like a target.
verses.16:13: They surrounded me with spears, striking into my kidneys; without sparing, they poured out my gall onto the ground;
verses.16:14: they cast me down, fall upon fall; they ran toward me in might.
verses.16:15: They sewed sackcloth upon my hide, and my strength was extinguished in the earth.
verses.16:16: My belly has been scorched from weeping, and on my eyelids is a shadow;
verses.16:17: yet nothing unrighteous was in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
verses.16:18: Earth, do not cover over the blood of my flesh, nor may there be a place for my cry.
verses.16:19: And now, look, my witness is in the heavens, and my confidant is in the highest places.
verses.16:20: May my supplication reach the Lord, and before Him may my eye drip.
verses.16:21: And may there be an argument for a man before the Lord, and for a son of man with his neighbor.
verses.16:22: And numbered years have come, and I will go by a way by which I will not return."
verses.17:1: "I am perishing, carried away by a wind, and I beg for burial and do not obtain it.
verses.17:2: I plead while weary, and having done what?
verses.17:3: And strangers have stolen my possessions; who is this? Let him be bound to my hand.
verses.17:4: Because You have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore You will certainly not exalt them.
verses.17:5: For the portion he will report evils, and eyes have melted away over sons.
verses.17:6: Yet You have made me a byword among nations, and I have become a laughingstock to them.
verses.17:7: For my eyes have grown dim from anger; I have been greatly besieged by all.
verses.17:8: Astonishment seized the truthful at this, and may a righteous one rise up against a lawless one;
verses.17:9: and may a faithful one hold to his own way, and may one with clean hands take up courage.
verses.17:10: However, press on, all of you, and come now, for I do not find anything true among you.
verses.17:11: My days have passed by in a roar, and the joints of my heart have been torn apart.
verses.17:12: I have turned night into day; light is near in the face of darkness.
verses.17:13: For if I wait, Hades is my house, and in gloom my bed has been spread.
verses.17:14: I have called upon death to be my father, and decay to be my mother and sister.
verses.17:15: Where then is my hope any longer? Or will I see my good things?
verses.17:16: Or will they go down with me to Hades, or will we go down together upon dust?"
verses.18:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,
verses.18:2: "How long will you not stop? Hold back, so that we ourselves may also speak.
verses.18:3: Why have we kept silent like four-footed animals before you?
verses.18:4: Anger has made use of you. What then? If you die, will the earth under heaven be uninhabited? Or will mountains be overturned from their foundations?
verses.18:5: And the light of the ungodly will be extinguished, and their flame will not come forth.
verses.18:6: His light is darkness in the dwelling, and the lamp will be extinguished for him.
verses.18:7: May the least hunt down his possessions, and may his counsel fail.
verses.18:8: And his foot has been cast into a snare; may he be entangled in a net.
verses.18:9: And may snares come upon him; He will strengthen thirsty ones against him.
verses.18:10: His rope has been hidden in the ground, and his capture is upon paths.
verses.18:11: May pains destroy him all around, and may many come around his foot in severe famine,
verses.18:12: and a terrible downfall has been prepared for him.
verses.18:13: May the branches of his feet be eaten, and death will devour his beauty.
verses.18:14: And may healing be torn away from his dwelling, and may distress seize him on a royal charge.
verses.18:15: It will dwell in his tent in his night; his splendid things will be strewn with sulfur.
verses.18:16: From below his roots will dry up, and from above his harvest will fall.
verses.18:17: May his memory perish from the earth, and there is a name for him on the face farther outside.
verses.18:18: May He drive him away from light into darkness.
verses.18:19: He will not be recognized among his people, nor will his house be saved on the earth under heaven,
verses.18:20: but others will live in what is his. The last groaned over him, and astonishment seized the first.
verses.18:21: These are the houses of the unrighteous, and this is the place of those who do not know the Lord."
verses.19:2: "How long will you make my soul weary and tear me down with words? Only know that the Lord has made me like this.
verses.19:3: You speak against me; without being ashamed before me, you press upon me.
verses.19:4: Yes, indeed, in truth I have erred, and error lodges with me, to speak words that ought not to be spoken, and my words err and are not in season.
verses.19:5: Yet let that be, for you magnify yourselves against me; and you leap upon me with reproach.
verses.19:6: Know therefore that the Lord is the One who has troubled me, and He has raised up His stronghold against me.
verses.19:7: Look, I laugh at reproach, and I will not speak; I will cry out, and nowhere is there justice.
verses.19:8: I have been walled in all around, and I will certainly not pass through; He set darkness upon my face.
verses.19:9: He stripped the glory from me, and He removed a crown from my head.
verses.19:10: He tore me apart all around, and I was gone; and He cut down my hope like a tree.
verses.19:11: He dealt with me terribly in anger, and He regarded me like an enemy.
verses.19:12: Together His raiding bands came against me; men lying in ambush surrounded my ways.
verses.19:13: My brothers withdrew from me; they recognized strangers rather than me, and my friends have become merciless.
verses.19:14: Those closest to me did not acknowledge me, and those who knew my name forgot me.
verses.19:15: Neighbors of the house and my maidservants: I was a foreigner before them.
verses.19:16: I called my servant, and he did not answer; and my mouth was begging,
verses.19:17: and I was imploring my wife, and I was calling to the sons of my concubines, flattering them;
verses.19:18: but they rejected me forever; whenever I rise up, they speak against me.
verses.19:19: Those who saw me loathed me; the very ones whom I had loved rose up against me.
verses.19:20: In my skin my flesh rotted, and my bones are held in teeth.
verses.19:21: Have mercy on me, have mercy on me, friends, for the hand of the Lord is what has touched me.
verses.19:22: Why do you pursue me just as the Lord also does, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.19:23: For who would grant that my words be written, and that they be placed in a book forever,
verses.19:24: with an iron stylus and lead?
verses.19:25: For I know that the One who is about to release me is eternal.
verses.19:26: May He raise up on earth my skin that endures these things. For from the Lord these things were accomplished for me,
verses.19:27: which I myself know within myself, which my eye has seen, and not another; and all things have been accomplished for me in my bosom.
verses.19:28: And if you also say, 'What will we say before him? And we will find a root of a matter in him,'
verses.19:29: then you yourselves also beware of a covering; for wrath will come upon the lawless, and then they will know where their substance is."
verses.20:1: Then Zophar the Minaean answered and said:
verses.20:2: "I did not suppose that you would reply with these things like this, and you do not understand any more than I also do.
verses.20:3: I will hear the discipline of my shame, and a spirit from understanding will answer me.
verses.20:4: Have you known these things from of old, since man was placed on the earth?
verses.20:5: Now the gladness of the ungodly is a dreadful downfall, and the joy of the lawless is destruction,
verses.20:6: even if his gifts ascend to heaven, and his sacrifice touches the clouds.
verses.20:7: For when he thinks he is already firmly established, then he will utterly perish; and those who knew him will say, 'Where is he?'
verses.20:8: Like a dream that has taken flight, he will by no means be found, and he has flown away like a night vision;
verses.20:9: an eye caught a glimpse, and will not do so again, and his place will no longer notice him.
verses.20:10: May inferiors destroy his sons, and may his hands burn with pains.
verses.20:11: His bones were filled with his youth, and it will sleep with him on the dust.
verses.20:12: If wickedness becomes sweet in his mouth, he will hide it under his tongue,
verses.20:13: he will not spare it and will not abandon it, and he will gather it in the middle of his throat,
verses.20:14: and he will by no means be able to help himself; the gall of an asp is in his belly.
verses.20:15: Wealth unjustly gathered will be vomited up; an angel will drag it out of his house.
verses.20:16: May he suck the venom of dragons, and may the tongue of a serpent kill him.
verses.20:17: May he not see the milking of grazing herds, nor pastures of honey and butter.
verses.20:18: For empty and futile things he labored, wealth of which he will not taste, like gristle, unchewable, unswallowable.
verses.20:19: For he crushed the houses of many powerful ones; he seized a dwelling and did not establish it.
verses.20:20: There is no safety for his possessions; in his desire he will not be saved.
verses.20:21: There is no remnant of his food; therefore his good things will not flourish.
verses.20:22: And when he thinks he is already filled, he will be afflicted, and every distress will come upon him.
verses.20:23: If somehow he should fill his belly, may He send forth upon him the fury of wrath; may He shower pains upon him;
verses.20:24: and he will by no means be saved from the hand of iron; may a bronze bow wound him;
verses.20:25: and may an arrow pass through his body, and may stars walk about in his dwellings; terrors are upon him,
verses.20:26: and may all darkness await him; an unkindled fire will devour him, and may a stranger harm his house.
verses.20:27: May heaven uncover his lawless deeds, and may the earth rise up against him.
verses.20:28: May destruction utterly drag away his house; may a day of wrath come upon him.
verses.20:29: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of what belongs to him from the Overseer."
verses.21:2: "Listen, listen to my words, so that I may not have this comfort from you.
verses.21:3: Bear with me, and I will speak; then you will not mock me.
verses.21:4: What then? Is my reproof of a man? Or why should I not be angry?
verses.21:5: Looking at me, you will be astonished, placing a hand on your cheek.
verses.21:6: For if I remember, I am agitated, and pains grip my flesh.
verses.21:7: Why do the ungodly live, and why have they grown old even in wealth?
verses.21:8: Their seed is according to their desire, and their children are before their eyes.
verses.21:9: Their houses prosper, and fear is nowhere, and a scourge from the Lord is not upon them.
verses.21:10: Their cow did not miscarry, and their pregnant one was brought safely through and did not fail.
verses.21:11: And they remain like eternal sheep, and their little children play;
verses.21:12: taking up harp and lyre, they also rejoice at the sound of a song.
verses.21:13: And they finished their life in good things, and in the rest of Hades they fell asleep.
verses.21:14: Yet he says to the Lord, 'Depart from me; I do not wish to know Your ways.
verses.21:15: What is the Sufficient One, that we should serve Him? And what benefit is there that we should meet Him?'
verses.21:16: For their good things were in their hands, yet He does not look upon the works of the ungodly.
verses.21:17: Nevertheless, the lamp of the ungodly will also be extinguished, and ruin will come upon them, and pangs will grip them from wrath.
verses.21:18: And they will be like chaff before the wind, or like dust which a whirlwind has carried off.
verses.21:19: May his possessions fail his sons; He will repay him, and he will know.
verses.21:20: May his eyes see his own slaughter, and from the Lord may he not be saved;
verses.21:21: for his pleasure is in his house with him, and the numbers of his months have been divided.
verses.21:22: Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge? And He Himself will judge murders.
verses.21:23: This one will die in the strength of his simplicity, wholly at ease and prospering,
verses.21:24: and his inward parts are full of fat, and his marrow is diffused;
verses.21:25: while another dies from bitterness of soul, having eaten nothing good;
verses.21:26: yet together they sleep on the earth, and decay has covered them.
verses.21:27: So I know you, that with audacity you press upon me,
verses.21:28: so that you will say, 'Where is the house of a ruler? And where is the shelter of the tents of the ungodly?'
verses.21:29: Ask those passing along the road, and you will not treat their signs as alien,
verses.21:30: for the evil man is relieved for a day of destruction; they will be led away for a day of his wrath.
verses.21:31: Who will declare his way to his face? And what he himself has done, who will repay him?
verses.21:32: And he himself was carried away to the tombs, and he himself kept watch upon mounds.
verses.21:33: The pebbles of the torrent have become sweet to him, and after him every man will depart, and before him are countless ones.
verses.21:34: How then do you comfort me with empty things? And my resting from you is nothing."
verses.22:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.22:2: "Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge?
verses.22:3: For what does it matter to the Lord if you were blameless in your works? Or is it a benefit that you should reject your way?
verses.22:4: Or taking account of you, will He reprove you and enter with you into judgment?
verses.22:5: Is not your wickedness great, and are not your sins innumerable?
verses.22:6: And you kept taking pledges from your brothers for nothing, and you took away the clothing of the naked.
verses.22:7: You did not even give the thirsty water to drink, but you deprived the hungry of a morsel.
verses.22:8: And you showed partiality to some, and you settled those on the earth.
verses.22:9: And you sent widows away empty, and you afflicted orphans.
verses.22:10: Therefore snares surrounded you, and extraordinary war dismayed you.
verses.22:11: The light turned into darkness for you, and when you lay down to sleep, water covered you.
verses.22:12: Does not He who dwells in the heights observe, and has He not humbled those carried along by arrogance?
verses.22:13: And you said, 'What does the Mighty One know, or does He judge through the gloom?
verses.22:14: A cloud of concealment is His, and He will not be seen, and He passes along the circle of heaven.'
verses.22:15: Will you keep the ancient path that righteous men trod,
verses.22:16: who were seized before their time? Their foundations are an overflowing river.
verses.22:17: They are those who say, 'What will the Lord do to us? Or what will the Almighty bring upon us?'
verses.22:18: Yet He filled their houses with good things, and the counsel of the ungodly is far from Him.
verses.22:19: Seeing this, the righteous laughed, and the blameless mocked:
verses.22:20: Surely their substance has been wiped out, and fire will devour their remnant.
verses.22:21: Be firm now, if you endure; then your fruit will be in good things.
verses.22:22: And bring out a declaration from His mouth, and take up His words in your heart.
verses.22:23: And if you turn back and humble yourself before the Lord, you have put what is unjust far from your dwelling;
verses.22:24: you will place yourself upon a mound in a rock, and as a rock of a torrent of Sophir.
verses.22:25: Therefore the Almighty will be your helper from enemies, and He will restore you pure like silver refined by fire.
verses.22:26: Then you will have boldness before the Lord, looking up to heaven cheerfully.
verses.22:27: And when you pray to Him, He will listen to you, and He will grant you to pay your vows.
verses.22:28: And He will restore to you a dwelling of righteousness, and upon your ways there will be radiance.
verses.22:29: For you humbled yourself, and you will say, 'He acted arrogantly,' and He will save the one downcast in his eyes.
verses.22:30: He will rescue an innocent person, and be saved by your pure hands."
verses.23:2: "Indeed, I know that reproof is out of my hand, and His hand has become heavy upon my groaning.
verses.23:3: And who then would know that I might find Him and come to the end?
verses.23:4: And I would state my own case, and He would fill my mouth with reproofs;
verses.23:5: and I would know the remedies that He will speak to me, and I would perceive what things He will declare to me.
verses.23:6: And in great strength He will come upon me; then He will not treat me with a threat.
verses.23:7: For truth and reproof are from Him, and may He bring forth my case to the end.
verses.23:8: For I will go to the first things, and I am no longer; and of the things at the last, what do I know?
verses.23:9: When He worked on the left, I did not lay hold; He will turn around on the right, and I will not see.
verses.23:10: For He already knows my way, and He has tested me like gold.
verses.23:11: And I will go forth in His commandments, for I kept His ways and will by no means turn aside; from His commandments
verses.23:12: indeed I will by no means depart, and in my bosom I have hidden His words.
verses.23:13: And if indeed He Himself judged in this way, who is the one to contradict Him? For what He Himself willed, He also did.
verses.23:15: Because of this I have been dismayed at Him; and being admonished, I took thought of Him. On this account I will be greatly dismayed before His presence; I will consider, and I will be terrified of Him.
verses.23:16: And the Lord has weakened my heart, and the Almighty has dismayed me.
verses.23:17: For I did not know that darkness would come upon me, and before my face gloom covered me."
verses.24:1: "And why have seasons escaped the notice of the Lord,
verses.24:2: while the ungodly have crossed over a boundary, seizing a flock together with the shepherd?
verses.24:3: They led away the pack animal of orphans, and they took a widow's ox in pledge.
verses.24:4: They turned the powerless aside from a righteous way, and all together the meek of the earth hid themselves.
verses.24:5: And they went off like donkeys in a field, going out from their own station on my behalf; bread was sweetened for him for the younger ones.
verses.24:6: Before the season they reaped a field that was not theirs; the powerless worked the vineyards of the ungodly without wages and without food.
verses.24:7: They made many sleep naked without garments, and they took away the clothing of their soul.
verses.24:8: They are soaked from the showers of the mountains; because they have no shelter for themselves, they wrapped themselves in a rock.
verses.24:9: They seized an orphan from the breast, and they humbled one who had fallen.
verses.24:10: And they made them sleep naked unjustly, and they took away the morsel of the hungry.
verses.24:11: In narrow places they lay in ambush unjustly, and the way of the righteous they did not know.
verses.24:12: They were being cast out from the city and their own houses, and the soul of infants groaned loudly.
verses.24:13: And why has He not made an inspection of these things? While they were on the earth, they did not even perceive, and the way of righteousness they did not know, nor did they walk in their paths.
verses.24:14: Yet knowing their works, He handed them over into darkness, and by night he will be like a thief.
verses.24:15: And the eye of an adulterer watched for darkness, saying, 'No eye will notice me,' and he put on a covering for his face.
verses.24:16: In darkness he dug through houses; by day they sealed themselves in; they did not recognize light;
verses.24:17: for to them all together the morning is the shadow of death, for he will recognize the turmoil of the shadow of death.
verses.24:18: He is swift upon the face of the water; may their portion be cursed on the earth,
verses.24:19: and may their plants appear dry on the earth; for they seized the sheaf of orphans.
verses.24:20: Then his sin was remembered, and like a mist of dew he vanished; and may what he did be repaid to him, and may every unjust person be shattered just like an incurable tree.
verses.24:21: And he did not do good to a barren woman, and he did not show mercy to one without a wife,
verses.24:22: and in wrath he overthrew the powerless. Therefore, when he rises up, he will by no means have confidence regarding his own life.
verses.24:23: When he falls ill, let him not hope to be healed, but he will fall by disease.
verses.24:24: For his exaltation afflicted many; yet he withered like mallow in the heat, or like an ear of grain falling off from a stalk of its own accord.
verses.24:25: And if not, who is the one who says that I speak falsehoods, and will turn my words into nothing?"
verses.25:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.25:2: "For what prelude or fear is from Him, the One who makes the whole universe in the highest?
verses.25:3: For could anyone suppose that there is respite for raiders? And upon whom will an ambush from Him not come?
verses.25:4: For how will a mortal be righteous before the Lord? Or who, born of a woman, could purify himself?
verses.25:5: Indeed, He commands the moon, and it does not shine; and the stars are not pure before Him.
verses.25:6: Yet alas, man is decay, and a son of man is a worm."
verses.26:2: "To whom are you attached, or whom are you going to help? Is it not the One who has great strength and who has a mighty arm?
verses.26:3: Whom have you consulted? Is it not the One who has all wisdom? Whom will you follow? Is it not the One who has the greatest power?
verses.26:4: To whom have you declared words? And whose breath is it that came out from you?
verses.26:5: Surely giants will not be brought forth from beneath the water and its neighbors?
verses.26:6: Hades is naked before Him, and there is no covering for destruction.
verses.26:7: He stretches out the north over nothing, hanging the earth upon nothing.
verses.26:8: He binds water in His clouds, and no cloud bursts beneath it;
verses.26:9: He is the One who holds the face of the throne, spreading out His cloud over it.
verses.26:10: He drew a decree in a circle upon the face of the water until the end of light with darkness.
verses.26:11: The pillars of heaven took flight and were astounded at His rebuke.
verses.26:12: By strength He stilled the sea, and by understanding the sea monster has been laid low.
verses.26:13: And the bars of heaven dread Him; and by a decree He put to death a rebellious dragon.
verses.26:14: Look, these are parts of His way, and we will hear to the extent of a drop of a word in Him; but the might of His thunder, who knows when He will make it?"
verses.27:1: And continuing further, Job spoke in his prelude:
verses.27:2: "As God lives, who has judged me in this way, and the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter,
verses.27:3: surely, while my breath is still in me and the divine spirit remains in my nostrils,
verses.27:4: my lips will not speak lawless things, nor will my soul meditate on unjust things.
verses.27:5: Far be it from me to declare you righteous until I die, for I will not relinquish my innocence;
verses.27:6: but holding fast to righteousness, I will by no means let go, for I am not conscious in myself of having done wrong things.
verses.27:7: Nevertheless, may my enemies be like the overthrow of the ungodly, and those who rise up against me like the destruction of lawbreakers.
verses.27:8: For what hope indeed is there for an ungodly man, that he holds on? Trusting in the Lord, will he then be saved?
verses.27:9: Or will God hear his plea? Or when distress comes upon him,
verses.27:10: does he have any boldness before Him? Or as he calls out, will He hear him?
verses.27:11: But now, I will declare to you what is in the hand of the Lord; I will not lie about the things that are with the Almighty.
verses.27:12: Look, you all know that you heap empty things upon empty things.
verses.27:13: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of mighty ones will come from the Almighty upon them.
verses.27:14: And if their sons become many, they will be for slaughter; and even if they grow to manhood, they will beg;
verses.27:15: and no one will have mercy on their widows.
verses.27:16: If he gathers silver like earth, and prepares gold equal to clay,
verses.27:17: the righteous will acquire all these things, and the truthful will possess his wealth.
verses.27:18: And his house turned out like moths and like a spider.
verses.27:19: A rich man lay down to sleep and will not do so again; he opened his eyes, and he is no more.
verses.27:20: Pains met him like water, and by night gloom stole him away.
verses.27:21: And a scorching wind will take him up, and he will go away, and it will winnow him out of his place.
verses.27:22: And it will fling him down and will not spare; from its hand he will surely flee.
verses.27:23: They will clap their hands at him and hiss him out of his place."
verses.28:1: For there is a place for silver from which it comes, and a place for gold where it is refined.
verses.28:2: For iron comes from the earth, and copper is quarried like stone.
verses.28:3: He set an order for darkness, and He Himself closely examines every limit: a stone of gloom and shadow of death,
verses.28:4: a cleft of a torrent from dust; and those who forget a righteous way grew weak from among mortals.
verses.28:5: The earth: from it bread will come forth; beneath it, it was turned over like fire.
verses.28:6: Its stones are a place of sapphire, and it has gold dust.
verses.28:7: A path: no bird has known it, and the eye of a vulture has not caught sight of it;
verses.28:8: and sons of the arrogant have not trodden it; a lion has not passed over it.
verses.28:9: Upon sharp rock He stretched out His hand, and He overturned mountains from the roots;
verses.28:10: and He broke open whirlpools of rivers, and my eye saw everything precious;
verses.28:11: and He uncovered the depths of rivers, and He displayed His own power to the light.
verses.28:12: But from where was wisdom found? And what is the place of knowledge?
verses.28:13: A mortal does not know its way, nor indeed was it found among humans.
verses.28:14: The abyss said, "It is not in me," and the sea said, "It is not with me."
verses.28:15: One will not give an enclosure in place of it, and silver will not be weighed out for it as its exchange;
verses.28:16: and it will not be weighed against gold of Sophir, with precious onyx and sapphire;
verses.28:17: gold and glass will not be equaled to it, nor will its exchange be vessels of gold.
verses.28:18: Lofty things and gabis will not be mentioned, and draw wisdom above the innermost things;
verses.28:19: topaz of Ethiopia will not be equaled to it; it will not be weighed against pure gold.
verses.28:20: But from where was wisdom found? And what is the place of understanding?
verses.28:21: It has escaped the notice of every human, and it was hidden from the birds of heaven.
verses.28:22: Destruction and death said, "We, however, have heard its report."
verses.28:23: God well established its way, and He Himself knows its place.
verses.28:24: For He Himself looks upon all that is under heaven, knowing all the things on the earth
verses.28:25: He made, a weight of winds, measures of water,
verses.28:26: when He made them; thus, having seen, He numbered them, and a way in a shaking, sounds.
verses.28:27: Then He saw it and declared to it; having prepared it, He searched it out.
verses.28:28: And He said to humanity, "Look, reverence for God is wisdom, and to abstain from evil things is knowledge."
verses.29:1: And continuing further, Job spoke in his prelude:
verses.29:2: "Who would place me as in a former month of the days in which God guarded me?
verses.29:3: As when His lamp shone above my head, when by His light I walked in darkness;
verses.29:4: when I was pressing heavily upon the ways, when God kept watch over my house;
verses.29:5: when I was exceedingly wooded, and my servants were around me;
verses.29:6: when my ways flowed with butter, and my mountains flowed with milk;
verses.29:7: when I went out at dawn in the city, and in the squares my seat was set.
verses.29:8: Seeing me, young men hid themselves, and all the older men stood up;
verses.29:9: and prominent men stopped speaking, placing a finger on their mouth.
verses.29:10: And those who heard called me blessed, and their tongue clung to their throat;
verses.29:11: for an ear heard and called me blessed, and an eye, seeing me, turned aside.
verses.29:12: For I rescued a poor person from the hand of a mighty one, and I helped an orphan who had no helper.
verses.29:13: May the blessing of one who is perishing come upon me, and the mouth of a widow blessed me.
verses.29:14: And I had put on righteousness, and I clothed myself in justice like a cloak.
verses.29:15: I was an eye to the blind, and a foot to the lame.
verses.29:16: I was a father of the powerless, and a case that I did not know I searched out;
verses.29:17: and I shattered the molars of the unrighteous; from the middle of their teeth I snatched away prey.
verses.29:18: And I said, 'My lifespan will grow old; like the trunk of a palm tree, I will live a long time;
verses.29:19: the root is opened wide upon water, and dew will lodge in my harvest;
verses.29:20: my glory is new with me, and my bow goes forward in his hand.'
verses.29:21: Hearing me, they paid attention, and they kept silent at my counsel;
verses.29:22: to my word they did not add, and they became overjoyed whenever I spoke to them.
verses.29:23: Just as thirsty earth waits for the rain, so did these for my speech.
verses.29:24: If I laugh at them, they will by no means believe it; and the light of my face did not fall away.
verses.29:25: I chose their way and sat as chief, and I encamped like a king among light-armed troops, just as one comforting those who suffer."
verses.30:1: But now they have laughed at me; the least ones now admonish me in turn, whose fathers I disdained, whom I did not consider worthy of the dogs of my flocks.
verses.30:2: And indeed, what is the strength of their hands to me? Upon them completion has perished.
verses.30:3: Barren in want and famine, those fleeing a waterless land yesterday, distress and misery;
verses.30:4: those surrounding saltwort by what resounds, whose food was saltwort; dishonored and despised, in want of every good thing.
verses.30:6: whose houses were caverns of rocks;
verses.30:7: among melodious ones, those who lived under wild brushwood will cry out;
verses.30:8: sons of fools and a name of the dishonored, and a reputation extinguished from the earth.
verses.30:9: But now I am their lyre, and they have me as a byword;
verses.30:10: and they abhorred me, standing far away, and from my face they did not withhold spit.
verses.30:11: For He opened His quiver and afflicted me, and He sent away the bridle of my face.
verses.30:12: On the right of a shoot they rose up; they stretched out their foot and made paths of their destruction against me.
verses.30:13: My paths were wiped out, for they stripped off my robe.
verses.30:14: With His darts He pierced me; He has treated me as He wills; I am steeped in pains.
verses.30:15: My pains turn back; my hope departed like wind, and like a cloud my salvation.
verses.30:16: And now my soul will be poured out upon me, and days of pains hold me;
verses.30:17: and by night my bones are confounded, and my sinews are loosened.
verses.30:18: With great strength He took hold of my robe; like the collar of my tunic He encompassed me.
verses.30:19: And You have considered me equal to clay; in earth and ashes is my portion.
verses.30:20: And I cry out to You, and You do not hear me; and they stood and observed me,
verses.30:21: and they came upon me mercilessly; with a mighty hand You scourged me;
verses.30:22: and You placed me in pains, and You cast me away from salvation.
verses.30:23: For I know that death will wipe me out; for the earth is a house for every mortal.
verses.30:24: If only I were able to lay hands on myself, or at least having asked another, and he will do this for me.
verses.30:25: Yet I wept over every powerless person, and I groaned when I saw a man in distresses.
verses.30:26: And while I was waiting for good things, look, days of evil things met me instead.
verses.30:27: My belly boiled over and will not be silent; days of poverty overtook me.
verses.30:28: Groaning I have walked without a muzzle, and I stand in the assembly crying out.
verses.30:29: I have become a brother of sirens, and a companion of ostriches.
verses.30:30: And my skin has been greatly darkened, and my bones from heat.
verses.30:31: And my lyre turned into grief, and my song into weeping for me.
verses.31:1: I made a covenant with my eyes. And I will not think upon a virgin.
verses.31:2: And yet God apportioned from above, and an inheritance of the Sufficient One from on high.
verses.31:3: Woe, destruction for the unrighteous, and alienation for those who practice lawlessness.
verses.31:4: Will He Himself not see my way, and will not all my steps be numbered?
verses.31:5: And if I had walked with mockers, and if my foot hurried to deceit,
verses.31:6: for I have been weighed in a just balance, and the Lord knows my innocence;
verses.31:7: if my foot turned aside from the way, and if my heart followed my eye, and if with my hands I touched gifts,
verses.31:8: then may I sow and may others eat, and may I become rootless upon the earth.
verses.31:9: If my heart followed after the wife of another man, and if I lay in wait at her doors,
verses.31:10: then may my wife also please another, and may my little children be brought low.
verses.31:11: For it is an uncontrollable fury of wrath to defile a man's wife;
verses.31:12: for it is a fire burning over all parts, and wherever it comes, it destroys from the roots.
verses.31:13: And if I despised the claim of my manservant or maidservant when they contended against me,
verses.31:14: for what will I do if the Lord makes an examination of me? And if also a visitation, what answer will I make?
verses.31:15: Just as I myself came into being in the womb, have they not also come into being? And we have come into being in the same womb.
verses.31:16: And the powerless did not fail to obtain whatever need they ever had, and I did not cause the eye of a widow to waste away;
verses.31:17: and if I ate my morsel alone and did not share with an orphan;
verses.31:18: because from my youth I nurtured like a father, and from my mother's womb I guided;
verses.31:19: and if I overlooked a naked person perishing and did not clothe him;
verses.31:20: and if the powerless did not bless me, and their shoulders were warmed from the fleece of my lambs;
verses.31:21: if I lifted a hand against an orphan, trusting that much help is at hand for me,
verses.31:22: then may my shoulder fall away from the collarbone, and may my arm be shattered from the elbow.
verses.31:23: For fear gripped me, and because of His burden I will not endure.
verses.31:24: If I placed gold in my dust, and if I trusted in a precious stone,
verses.31:25: and if I rejoiced when my wealth became great, and if I laid my hand upon innumerable things;
verses.31:26: or do we not see the shining sun eclipsing, and the moon waning? For it is not in their power;
verses.31:27: and if my heart was secretly deceived, and if I placed my hand on my mouth and kissed it,
verses.31:28: then may this also be counted to me as the greatest lawlessness, because I lied before the Lord Most High.
verses.31:29: And if I exulted at the downfall of my enemies, and my heart said, "Well done,"
verses.31:30: then may my ear hear my curse, and then may I be made a byword by my people while being afflicted.
verses.31:31: And if my maidservants often said, "Who would grant us to be filled with his flesh?" while I was very kind;
verses.31:32: and outside a stranger did not spend the night, and my door stood open to everyone who came;
verses.31:33: and if, having sinned unintentionally, I hid my sin,
verses.31:34: for I did not shrink from a throng of a multitude so as not to confess before them; and if I allowed a powerless person to go out my door with an empty bosom;
verses.31:35: who would grant someone to hear me? And if I had not feared the hand of the Lord, a written bond that I had against someone,
verses.31:36: having placed it upon my shoulders as a crown, I would have read it,
verses.31:37: and if I did not tear it up and give it back, taking nothing from a debtor;
verses.31:38: if the land ever groaned against me, and if its furrows wept with one accord;
verses.31:39: and if I ate its strength alone without payment, and if I seized and grieved the soul of the owner of the land;
verses.31:40: then instead of wheat may nettle come forth for me, and instead of barley, bramble. And Job ceased from words.
verses.32:1: Now his three friends also ceased speaking against Job any longer, for Job was righteous before them.
verses.32:2: Then Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, from the family of Ram, of the land of Uz, became angry; he became very angry with Job because he declared himself righteous before the Lord.
verses.32:3: And he also became very angry against the three friends, because they were not able to give opposing answers to Job, and they considered him to be ungodly.
verses.32:4: Now Elihu waited to give an answer to Job, because they were older than he in days.
verses.32:5: And Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, and he became furious in his anger.
verses.32:6: Then Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, "I am younger in time, while you are older; therefore I kept silent, fearing to declare to you my own knowledge.
verses.32:7: And I said, 'It is not time that speaks, and in many years they do not know wisdom;
verses.32:8: but there is a spirit in mortals, and it is the breath of the Almighty that teaches;
